title: Milbrook high school
titleCn: 米尔布鲁克高中新生信息说明会

paragraphs.text: You will hear a talk given by a high school principal to parents whose children will soon be starting at the school.
First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to fifteen.
Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to fifteen.
Hello everyone, and a very warm welcome to all our new parents and students to our information evening.

Millbrook High School has a long history. In fact, we recently celebrated our eightieth anniversary in this beautiful building, which dates back to the very early days of the school. We had a big assembly where we were given a talk by a special former student, the internationally renowned author, Jane Roberts. It was fascinating. She joined us in singing the school song and said it brought back very fond memories of singing those same words when she was a student here.

We are very proud of our academic achievements, but we're always striving to improve. There's an exciting change in our Japanese program that I want to tell you about this evening. Since the program started five years ago, we've been fortunate enough to have a wonderful teacher from Japan. And starting from this year, she'll be organizing a two-week trip to Japan for all students who would like to take part. We're very excited about this new development, which is a nice addition to our traditional annual visit by school children from our sister school in Japan.

The school website is constantly being updated with the latest news. I encourage you to check it often to see what work teachers have set for your child to do at home each week. This will help you to keep up with the tasks your children need to complete. Our teachers are more than happy to talk to parents, and you can organize a time to do that after class via the school office. The school office is also the place to take your textbook orders, by the way, and remember that they need to be in well before the start of school.

In terms of sport, we're very proud of how well our football team has done recently. They performed really well in the regional competition last month, just missing out on first place. This didn't dampen their spirits though, and they went on to raise over two hundred dollars to give to the local children's hospital through fundraising in the school.
We hope your child will be interested in joining one of our sporting clubs and proudly wearing the school team shirt.

We're always grateful if parents can help out at the school. The library, for example, always needs help with maintaining the records of the books we have in stock. That allows our wonderful teacher librarian to concentrate on other things, such as making sure that any torn or damaged books are fixed straight away and looking after the children when they come in to borrow books. Let reception know if you're interested.
Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty.
Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.

Now have a look at the map of the school, and I'll point out some places you might like to look around. You came in via the administration building on Main Road at the bottom of the map, and we're now in the assembly hall just behind that.
We're very proud of the Performing Arts Center, which you can see at the top of the map in the center. It's just past the tennis courts. We put on all our school plays and musical events there.

Now, a word about dropping off your children on school days. Always a busy time. There are two drop-off bays along Fern Street, but please only use the first bay near the classrooms rather than the second one near the sports hall. That's for buses only. Another important area to point out is the fire evacuation point. We used to meet just behind the assembly hall, but as we've grown so big, we now assemble on the netball courts, which is the oval shape you can see there in the top right-hand corner of the map. I'll point out the school canteen in case you want to join us for our family pancake breakfasts. It's an L-shaped building and can be easily accessed directly from the sports hall. For those of you needing IT help, such as for problems with school laptops, go to the IT center, which is to the left of the administration building. There's a covered walkway connecting it to the art block. We really hope your children...
That is the end of part two. You now have thirty seconds to check your answers to part two.
